summaries.en: Kim Jong Un guided a combined infantry and armored unit attack drill involving a new main battle tank equipped with an active protection system, emphasizing the tank's superiority and urging the "completion of war preparations."
summaries.zh: 朝鲜国务委员长金正恩指导了动用配备主动防护系统的新型主力坦克的步兵与装甲部队协同训练，强调了新型坦克的优越性并要求“完成备战”。
